Name: Scenario
Description: A short code of the 7 management scenarios simulated in the model.

Name: Fleet_name
Description: The name of the fishery. RecBFCatch = recreational deep-water catches; CommBFCatch= commercial deep-water catches; Spear=the total of recreational and commercial catches by spearfishing ; Net=the total of recreational and commercial catches by net fishing; Line=the total of recreational and commercial catches by (hook and) line fishing; Other=the total of recreational and commercial catches by other fishing methods;

Name: Catch_start
Description: The Ecopath with Ecosim model input in 2020 of the catch

Name: Catch_end
Description: The Ecopath with Ecosim model output in 2040 of the catch

Name: Catch_change
Description: The change between the end-to-start catches

Name: Value_start
Description: The Ecopath with Ecosim model input in 2020 of the value of the catch

Name: Value_end
Description: The Ecopath with Ecosim model output in 2040 of the value of the catch

Name: Value_change
Description: The change between the end-to-start value of the catches

Name: Effort_change
Description: The change between the end-to-start effort in fishing

Name: Group_name
Description: Functional group; these are the groups of species aggregated based on diet, life history, ecological role or economic importance

Name: Biomass_end
Description: The Ecopath with Ecosim model output in 2040 of the biomass

Name: Biomass_start
Description: The Ecopath with Ecosim model input in 2020 of the biomass

Name: Biomass_change
Description: The change between the end-to-start biomass

Name: Time
Description: Number of months since the start of the model simulation

Name: KemptonsQ
Description: The diversity of the marine community
